source_title: OKX to list Pendle (PENDLE) for spot trading

spot_trading_start.statement: OKX announced that PENDLE/USDT spot trading was scheduled to open at 07:00 UTC on 2024-09-27.

limitations: This record authenticates the project's source check, not an immutable copy of the third-party webpage.
The 06:00-07:00 UTC call auction is explicitly excluded from the continuous spot-trading start.
